description: This file defines an abstract class PdfGroupAttributes representing a PDF group XObject, including its associated keys and properties, within the PDFsharp library. It manages group attributes such as type and subtype for PDF group objects.

classes.name: PdfGroupAttributes
classes.description: An abstract class representing a PDF group XObject, setting 'Type' to '/Group' and defining group-specific attributes.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: A nested class defining keys for the PdfGroupAttributes dictionary, including 'Type' and 'S' (subtype).

methods.name: PdfGroupAttributes
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dictionary and setting the 'Type' key to '/Group'.
